name: Pizzeria Acasa
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Acasa in Innsbruck** serves up authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the city. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, their handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven. Pair your meal with a crisp **Aperol Spritz** or a refreshing **Radler** and enjoy the cozy atmosphere. Don’t miss their delicious **Tiramisu** for dessert—pure indulgence! A must-visit for pizza lovers in **Tirol**.
